doc.title: Joey Morant interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, April 2, 2013

title: Doc Pomus, Lieber and Stoller
summary: He recalls visiting Doc Pomus in hospital, people assuming he was black, and knowing Lieber and Stoller.

story.theme_name: Band pranks, jokes and gigs gone wrong
story.community_name: Pranks, practical jokes and band humor

blocks.x: I was in his hospital room every day to see him. And everybody thought he was black. See how people jump to assumption? They assumed he was black. They just assumed that, as if to say, oh somebody black got to do that. Not necessarily. He wrote all the hits.
Like Jerry Lieber and Mike Stoller.

There you go. I knew them too, very well. See? So there’s so much you can learn about life and man and his world, like “Desiderato.” I’ve got to mail him these. It’s a piece of prose written by an airline pilot, an unknown airline pilot, became a master to read. A masterpiece. “Desiderato.” You can pull it up, can’t you Linda? Linda: Oh yeah.
